I purchased mia secret xtra bond from Amazon really cheap. My nails have been on going on 7wks now. My ONLY complaint is I don't think the tubes were a complete 30g. 8 tubes in one kit for this price tho is a really good deal. I will purchase this kit again when I run out. reviews.t: Overall great product. Easy for beginners
reviews.x: I don’t usually leave reviews but this needs a little bit more credit.  I finished both of my hands in like 45 mins! The polygel was easy to remove from the tube and easy to apply to nail. Follow each step of the instructions to get the best results. You do not need a lot of the gel in the form, they are sturdy, do not apply a lot of pressure when applying to nails and when applying the top coat make sure it’s on nail only because when you cure it, the coat that runs on your fingers will burn!!
I absolutely love this kit, beautiful packaging and beautiful colors!!! Definitely ordering another one.. like right now!! Lol

I submitted a review that I want to apologize for. Yesterday was my first time using the product. Even though I applied hydration and primer to my nails, some of my nails lifted up within hours. I’m not happy at all. I was so excited to receive my poly gel. However, I just have to find a different method so it can adhere to my nails and not lift. You know the saying, practice makes perfect. My nails were pretty with all of the designs, they weren’t perfect but I liked them. Thanks will send more
Everything was fine works great. If you do hair then I say don’t get it because they will come off. I still recommend though.

I'd like a refund. First of all it's more effort than it's worth, second of all the back of the polygel tube randomly burst open and got all over the place. The nail popped off literally ten minutes after I spent two hours doing them. I prepped corrsctly, removed the nail shine first, washed my hands, did the first coat and cured it. Im trying to return it but due to covid 19 my ups locations in Tucson are closed so I'm kinda screwed. Don't buy this product.

Love these polygels. I prefer to sculpt my own nail and not use the nail forms that come with the product. Doesn’t harden until you place it in the nail lamp, so there is no pressure to get it done, you can take your time and do any correcting before placing your fingers in the nail lamp.
This is probably one of my favorite polygels. It was easy to use and the cuticle area didn’t lift. Still sturdy 2 weeks in!
No trae la lampara y el producto se cae rapido ( a lo mejor debo practicar mas .. no lo se , pero el producto queda aguado

reviews.t: It takes a few times to get it right, but then it's so rewarding. YouTube videos very helpful👍
reviews.x: This product is awesome DIY or not. The only thing I recommend is purchasing a nail dremel/speed filer. I'm a beginner and thankgod Amazon could overnight my dremel because if you have never done polygel it's likely you will need to file more than a professional. It just takes time to get the level of polygel needed& them u got it! Good product. Also have plenty of rubbing alcohol 90% on hand!👍😊

reviews.t: Takes a while but looks good!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the polygel easy to use and beginner-friendly, with good results when instructions are followed.
Several reviewers report nails lifting, peeling, or popping off quickly, even after prepping.
Some reviewers complain about packaging and leakage issues, including burst tubes, cracked slip guard, and spilled glitter.
A few reviewers note it takes practice and extra filing effort, especially for beginners.
Some reviewers praise the product so much they plan to repurchase or recommend it.
